name: George's Auto Repair
address: 1624 Spy Run Ave, Fort Wayne, IN 46805
serviceTitle: Auto and light truck service and repairs
serviceText: Cars and light trucks. Call (260) 422-7015 and describe what your vehicle is doing.
reviews: Excellent Service and nice staffs. I trust their services. The best mechanic in Fort Wayne, I think.
They have always done good work with a fair price. They always stand behind the work they do.
If you need your car or truck fixed... hands down, I'd recommend George's. Employees were helpful, polite, and accommodating. Prices are reasonable.
I recommend George’s Auto to anyone I know. They do excellent, and timely work. Very honest mechanics. Also, they have loaner cars or will offer you a ride home, if the job will take several hours.

qa.q: Do you have loaner cars, or can I get a ride home?
qa.a: A customer wrote on Google: “Also, they have loaner cars or will offer you a ride home, if the job will take several hours.” Call (260) 422-7015 to ask about your job.

qa.q: A dealership gave me a diagnosis. Can you take a second look?
qa.a: One customer wrote: “I took my 2007 F-150 in after getting an inaccurate diagnosis from a local (not Ford) dealership. The mechanic at George’s was able to quickly diagnose the issue.” Call (260) 422-7015 and describe what your vehicle is doing.
Customers say so. One wrote: “Very honest mechanics.” Another: “...was honest and told me the repairs would cost more than the vehicle was worth.”
